qualifier: sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium release and reuptake, contraction dampening
name: Muscle sarcoplasmic calcium release and cytosolic calcium reduction
rationale: All members regulate cytosolic calcium flux in cardiac or skeletal muscle (ryanodine-receptor release, SR import, Na/Ca exchange); unlike confusables the theme centres on SR calcium release control and negative regulation of contraction and heart rate rather than force enhancement or ER transport.

qualifier: BMAL1:CLOCK–CRY:PER core machinery with PPARA/PGC-1alpha metabolic coupling
name: Core circadian clock feedback loop and metabolic coupling
rationale: Members span the BMAL1:CLOCK/CRY:PER/ROR/REV-ERB clock loop plus its PPARA, PGC-1alpha and heme links; confusables are metabolic (gluconeogenesis, thermogenesis, beta-cell) and lack the core clock machinery.

core: T cell immunological synapse and polarity
qualifier: Vav1–Cdc42 signaling and membrane raft localization
name: T cell polarity and immunological synapse via Vav1–Cdc42 signaling
rationale: Members concern lymphocyte synapse formation, polarity, aggregation and homing driven by CD28–Vav1, Cdc42/Rho and PLC/PKC signaling; confusables emphasise integrin adhesion, antigen presentation or other RHO GTPase effectors.

qualifier: RUNX3 targets and cadherin genes
name: RUNX3 target and cadherin gene transcriptional regulation
rationale: Members regulate transcription of growth-restraining genes (RUNX3 targets BIM, CDKN1A, p14-ARF; CDH1, CDH11, TGFBR3; FOXO cell cycle genes); this distinguishes it from confusables centred on ALK/STAT3, PTEN/PD-L1 or RUNX3 WNT/YAP targets.

qualifier: primordial germ cell migration, survival and meiotic entry
name: Primordial germ cell migration, survival and meiotic entry
rationale: Members concern germ cells themselves (proliferation, migration, ectopic death, meiosis activation, maturation), whereas confusables cover gonadal somatic cells, gonadotropins or oocyte maturation.

qualifier: DAP12 signaling and neuron remodeling
name: DAP12-linked microglial activation and neuron remodeling
rationale: Members describe microglial/macrophage activation, proliferation, migration, cytotoxicity and fusion with DAP12 signaling and neuron remodeling; confusables instead centre on amyloid-beta and apoptotic cell clearance.

qualifier: downstream PLCG1, RAS and FRS2/3 branches
name: BDNF–TRKB signaling through PLCG1, RAS and FRS2/3
rationale: All members are BDNF-activated NTRK2 signaling; confusables cover the PI3K, CDK5, RAC1 branches, NTF3/NTRK3 or downstream CREB/ERK5 events instead.

qualifier: dorsoventral patterning of forebrain and spinal cord
name: Dorsoventral neural patterning, neuron fate specification and migration
rationale: Members cover regional patterning, neuron subtype commitment and interneuron/motor neuron migration in forebrain and spinal cord; confusables lack spinal cord and dorsoventral patterning and instead stress neuroblast division and commissure formation.

qualifier: receptor signaling, transporter reuptake and drug-reward behavior
name: Dopamine receptor signaling, catecholamine reuptake and drug reward behavior
rationale: Members cover dopamine receptor signaling, DAT/NET-mediated catecholamine uptake and behavioral responses to cocaine, amphetamine, nicotine and ethanol; confusables focus on catecholamine biosynthesis, MAO/COMT degradation or nicotinic receptors.

qualifier: cadmium transport and detoxification
name: Zinc transport and homeostasis with cadmium detoxification
rationale: Members are SLC30/SLC39 zinc influx, efflux and homeostasis plus cadmium transport and detoxification; confusables concern manganese, copper, iron or metallothionein responses.

qualifier: transsulfuration of homocysteine to cysteine
name: Transsulfuration and sulfur amino acid catabolism
rationale: All members belong to homocysteine-to-cysteine transsulfuration (serine as co-substrate) and cysteine/sulfur amino acid breakdown; confusables cover glycine, threonine, histidine or selenium/sulfide metabolism.

qualifier: KATP channels, incretins and fatty acid receptors
name: Insulin secretion control by KATP channels, incretins and fatty acids
rationale: Members regulate glucose-stimulated insulin secretion via KATP channels, GLP-1/GIP, FFAR1 fatty acid signaling and acetylcholine; confusables add adrenergic inhibition, glucagon or insulin processing instead.

qualifier: keratinocyte differentiation and cornification
name: Keratinocyte differentiation, cornification and skin appendage development
rationale: Members cover keratinocyte proliferation/differentiation, cornified envelope and barrier formation and hair, nail, sebaceous and mammary appendage development; confusables are dominated by melanocyte and pigmentation biology.

qualifier: astrocytic glutamate–glutamine cycling
name: Glutamate reuptake and astrocytic glutamate–glutamine cycling
rationale: All three members concern glutamate uptake across the plasma membrane and astrocytic glutamate–glutamine metabolism; confusables concern GABA, catecholamine or aspartate transport.

core: RNA virus life cycle in host cells
qualifier: coronavirus, influenza, RSV and dengue entry, replication, translation and assembly
name: RNA virus entry, genome replication, protein maturation and assembly
rationale: Members cover RNA virus attachment, entry, genome replication, viral translation, protein maturation and assembly plus host translational countermeasures; confusables concern retroviral reverse transcription and integration or herpesvirus latency.

core: Motile cilium and sperm flagellum function
qualifier: axonemal dynein and central apparatus assembly
name: Motile cilium axoneme assembly and sperm flagellar motility
rationale: Members concern motile cilia and sperm flagella (dynein arms, central apparatus, sperm mitochondrial sheath, motility, mucociliary clearance); confusables cover tubulin modification, intraflagellar transport and primary cilia.

qualifier: NOTCH1 intracellular domain and PEST-domain mutants
name: Notch target transcription by NOTCH1 intracellular domain and PEST mutants
rationale: Members concern Notch-driven HLH target transcription, specifically NOTCH1 NICD including PEST and HD+PEST constitutive mutants; confusables involve NOTCH2/3/4, HD-only or translocation mutants and signal transmission steps.

qualifier: adenylate cyclase activation, PKA and CREB
name: cAMP synthesis, degradation and PKA–CREB signaling
rationale: Members concern cAMP production by adenylate cyclases, its PDE degradation and PKA/DARPP-32/CREB activation; confusables cover adenylate cyclase inhibition, Gi/adrenergic, calcium/IP3 or CaMK-CREB routes.

qualifier: connexin assembly, trafficking and electrical coupling
name: Connexin gap junction assembly, trafficking and electrical coupling
rationale: Members cover connexin oligomerization, secretory trafficking, gap junction assembly/turnover and electrical/calcium coupling; confusables concern voltage-gated channels, axonal adhesion or presynaptic structure.

qualifier: vesicle endocytosis, recycling and active zone maintenance
name: Presynaptic vesicle endocytosis, recycling and active zone maintenance
rationale: Members regulate synaptic vesicle clustering, endocytosis, uncoating and recycling plus active zone/cytoskeleton maintenance; confusables cover vesicle docking/fusion release cycles, clathrin coat assembly or postsynaptic organisation.

core: RNA polymerase II transcription initiation and early elongation
qualifier: promoter escape, pausing, capping and HIV Tat
name: RNA polymerase II initiation and early elongation, including HIV Tat
rationale: Members cover Pol II pre-initiation, promoter escape, CTD phosphorylation and capping, and promoter-proximal pausing including HIV Tat-mediated elongation; confusables concern Pol I/III transcription, rRNA processing or termination.

qualifier: EGFR, ERBB2 and FGFR mutants, fusions and amplifications
name: Oncogenic EGFR, ERBB2 and FGFR mutant signaling in cancer
rationale: All members are constitutive signaling by cancer-associated RTK variants, mainly EGFR/ERBB2 mutants and FGFR1-3 fusions/amplifications; confusables centre on PDGFR, ALK and FLT3 variants.

qualifier: NOTCH2, NOTCH3 and NOTCH4 intracellular domains
name: Notch target transcription by NOTCH2, NOTCH3 and NOTCH4 intracellular domains
rationale: Members concern Notch-HLH target transcription by NOTCH2/3/4 NICDs and its contexts (Th2 differentiation, pancreatic bud, RUNX3); confusables are NOTCH1-specific signaling and mutants.

qualifier: translation factor post-translational modification (diphthamide, hypusine, hydroxylation)
name: Translation termination, mRNA surveillance and translation factor modification
rationale: Members cover translation termination, NMD, no-go and non-stop decay together with diphthamide/hypusine/hydroxylation modification of translation factors; confusables concern tRNA charging/modification, initiation or protein methylation.

qualifier: serotonin and tachykinin receptor signaling
name: Serotonin and tachykinin receptor signaling in gastrointestinal motility
rationale: Members cover serotonin and tachykinin receptor signaling with gastric/intestinal smooth muscle contraction, motility and acid secretion; confusables involve histamine, muscarinic or general smooth muscle contraction.
